description:
Lotus Beauty Co. creates skincare and cosmetics with women navigating cancer at the heart of our mission, while welcoming anyone who wants thoughtful beauty for sensitive or stressed skin. Our products are designed with both science and compassion in mind, helping women feel confident, cared for, and like themselves again.

The Lotus Circle is our thoughtfully chosen affiliate community. We’re looking for creators, advocates, beauty professionals, customers, and trusted community voices who value honest communication, genuine connection, and thoughtful beauty. Follower count matters far less to us than the trust you’ve built with the people you serve.

Lotus Circle Partners earn 10% commission on qualifying purchases and receive a personal 10% discount code to share with their community. As our partnership grows, select partners may be invited into our 15% Lotus Circle Ambassador tier, with opportunities for gifting, early access, and special collaborations.

We especially welcome partners creating content around beauty, skincare, sensitive skin, makeup, women’s wellness, confidence, survivorship, caregiving, and supportive communities. Applications are personally reviewed.
payout_period: Commissions are reviewed after a 45-day validation period to account for returns or refunds, then paid monthly once approved.
term_and_condition:
Lotus Circle Partner Terms

The Lotus Circle is built on trust, care, and genuine connection. By joining, you agree to share Lotus in a way that feels honest, thoughtful, and respectful of the women and communities we serve.

  • Share your genuine experience and opinions about Lotus.
  • Clearly disclose when you may earn a commission or when a product has been gifted to you.
  • Use current Lotus-approved product information when talking about our products.
  • Please do not make medical claims or suggest that Lotus products treat, prevent, cure, or guarantee relief from cancer, treatment side effects, or other medical conditions.
  • Please do not present yourself as an employee, medical expert, or official spokesperson for Lotus Beauty Co.
  • Your affiliate link and discount code are meant for genuine referrals and should not be used for self-referrals or misleading promotions.
  • Commission is earned on qualifying purchases. Returns, cancellations, refunds, fraudulent orders, or other ineligible purchases may result in commission being reversed.
  • Lotus may occasionally update program details, commission rates, offers, or participation guidelines as the program grows. We’ll communicate meaningful changes with you.
  • You or Lotus may end the partnership at any time.

Most of all, we ask that you share Lotus in a way that feels kind, inclusive, and true to both you and the heart of our brand.
